## 1.3.30 (HexGhoul): NPCs talk in speech bubbles over their heads (not the chat); the spouse keeps house instead of following you about; Touka leans in for a kiss; shut eyes show a line; a parent holds a baby the whole time (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.30 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 66**: client and server must both be 1.3.30). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- **Speech bubbles, not chat spam.** What Eto, Touka, Ken, your children and the ghouls say now shows in a bubble over their head, above their name and status. It's wrapped to a few short lines, actions like "*picks Mei up*" are grey and slanted, and it stays up long enough to read (longer for more words). The newest line replaces the last. Their lines stay private: only the player they're talking to sees the bubble. Only real game messages stay in chat (quests and hunts, marriage, "went home", lessons taught).
- **The spouse keeps house.** At the home you share, your spouse no longer trails you around or drops everything when you come near. They do a chore every 15 to 35 seconds alone (20 to 45 with you about), and in the middle of one they don't start anything with you. You can still talk to them, ask for a kiss or a hug, or take their hand.
- **Touka's kiss.** Asked for a kiss, she no longer throws an arm forward. Waiting for it she just leans in, eyes shut, arms loose at her sides. Only once you kiss her does one hand come up to your head, cheek or neck, over a moment, and her lean is kept the whole time (it used to drop and start again when the kiss landed). Held long enough, that same hand goes behind your head as she pulls you in.
- **Shut eyes.** When Touka (and Ken) blinked or shut their eyes for a kiss, the eyes just vanished. Now the lashes stay as they are, the row under them is skin, and there's one black line a pixel lower, where the owner marked it. Only the closed-eye overlays changed; the owner's skins are untouched.
- **A parent holds the baby the whole time.** A companion holding their child no longer drops the hold every few seconds and snaps back into it. The cradle used to run out after 96 ticks, fade away and get started again from nothing. Now it's held for as long as the child is in their arms, easing in only when they first pick the child up.

Untested in game: all of it is compiled and unit tested only (the bubbles use vanilla's own name tag drawing, stacked above the name).
